digest.component_or_area: Ruff linter configuration and datetime timezone validation
propositions: Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rule families must be enabled in the global Ruff configuration after all production and test code sites pass their respective checks.

Timestamp semantics must be explicitly UTC: epoch seconds use `datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(created, tz=datetime.timezone.utc)` and timezone-less persisted strings use `datetime.datetime.strptime(...).replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)`.

Timezone invariance of UTC timestamp clustering must be verified under at least two distinct TZ process environments on POSIX/macOS platforms via time.tzset(); test skips when time.tzset is unavailable.

Security-pin cadence must remain a host-local calendar-date decision obtained with `datetime.datetime.now(tz=datetime.timezone.utc).astimezone().date()`, passing the tz argument explicitly and complying with DTZ005.
Production code is prohibited from using the literal `datetime.UTC` token; all UTC construction uses `datetime.timezone.utc` for py310 compatibility.
Configuration contract assertions must verify ASYNC selection, DTZ selection, absence of the S security selector, and absence of .semgrep files/directories in tests/unit/test_ruff_ratchet.py.
